Description: Extended 2-AZ PrivateLink Squid provider with Amazon Kinesis Agent (AL2023 repository package). Original template unchanged.

ConsumerAccountId.Description: AWS account ID allowed to request access to this service (no default; provide at deploy time).

ProviderAzId1.Description: First physical AZ ID (use the same AZ ID in the consumer stack).

ProviderAzId2.Description: Second physical Availability Zone ID, different from ProviderAzId1. Coordinate with B.

FirehoseStreamName.Description: Output from the log-storage stack in this same account and region.

Properties.GroupDescription: Internal NLB accepts only approved PrivateLink consumer subnet traffic

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: PrivateLink traffic from B lab Lambda subnet only
PrivateLink traffic from B lab Lambda subnet AZ2

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: TCP proxy traffic and NLB health checks to Squid
Proxy traffic and health checks to Squid AZ2

Properties.GroupDescription: Squid accepts only NLB security group on port 3128; no SSH

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: From the NLB security group only

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: Proxy may establish HTTPS to approved external destinations

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec > >(tee -a /var/log/squid-agent-bootstrap.log) 2>&1
signal_exit() { code=$?; trap - EXIT; aws cloudformation signal-resource --stack-name '${AWS::StackId}' --logical-resource-id 'SquidInstanceAz1' --unique-id "$INSTANCE_ID" --status "$(if [ "$code" = 0 ]; then echo SUCCESS; else echo FAILURE; fi)" --region '${AWS::Region}' || true; exit "$code"; }
TOKEN=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 -X PUT -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600' http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token)
INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
trap signal_exit EXIT
# Install the AL2023 repository package, rather than an AL2 RPM.
dnf -y install java-17-amazon-corretto-headless
dnf -y install squid aws-kinesis-agent jq
systemctl stop aws-kinesis-agent || true
cp /etc/squid/squid.conf /etc/squid/squid.conf.original
cat >/etc/squid/squid.conf <<SQUID
http_port 3128
acl SSL_ports port 443
acl CONNECT method CONNECT
acl allowed_sites dstdomain checkip.amazonaws.com
http_access deny !CONNECT
http_access deny CONNECT !SSL_ports
http_access allow allowed_sites
http_access deny all
forwarded_for delete
via off
visible_hostname squid-agent-lab-az1
logfile_rotate 0
logformat agentlab %ts.%03tu %6tr %>a %Ss/%03>Hs %<st %rm %ru %un %Sh/%<a %mt source=az1 instance=$INSTANCE_ID request=%{X-Lab-Request}>h
access_log stdio:/var/log/squid/access.log agentlab CONNECT
SQUID
# Group access applies to newly created rotated files as well.
usermod -a -G squid aws-kinesis-agent-user
install -d -m 0750 -o squid -g squid /var/log/squid
touch /var/log/squid/access.log
chown squid:squid /var/log/squid/access.log
chmod 0640 /var/log/squid/access.log
cat >/etc/logrotate.d/squid <<'ROTATE'
/var/log/squid/access.log {
  daily
  missingok
  notifempty
  rotate -1
  nocompress
  dateext
  dateformat -%Y%m%d%H%M%S
  create 0640 squid squid
  sharedscripts
  postrotate
    /usr/sbin/squid -k rotate
  endscript
}
ROTATE
cat >/etc/aws-kinesis/agent.json <<'AGENT'
{
  "cloudwatch.emitMetrics": false,
  "checkpointFile": "/var/lib/aws-kinesis-agent/checkpoints",
  "firehose.endpoint": "https://firehose.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com",
  "flows": [{
    "filePattern": "/var/log/squid/access.log*",
    "deliveryStream": "${FirehoseStreamName}",
    "initialPosition": "START_OF_FILE",
    "aggregatedRecordSizeBytes": ${AggregatedRecordSizeBytes},
    "maxBufferAgeMillis": ${AgentMaxBufferAgeMillis},
    "maxBufferSizeBytes": 4194304,
    "maxBufferSizeRecords": 500,
    "minTimeBetweenFilePollsMillis": ${AgentPollMillis}
  }]
}
AGENT
chmod 0644 /etc/aws-kinesis/agent.json
JAVA17=$(rpm -ql java-17-amazon-corretto-headless | awk '/\/bin\/java$/ {print;exit}')
test -x "$JAVA17"
# AL2023 package ships a SysV wrapper; use an explicit native systemd unit.
cat >/etc/systemd/system/aws-kinesis-agent.service <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Amazon Kinesis Agent for Squid logs
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target squid.service
[Service]
Type=simple
User=aws-kinesis-agent-user
SupplementaryGroups=squid
StateDirectory=aws-kinesis-agent
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/aws-kinesis-agent
Environment="JAVACMD=$JAVA17"
Environment="JVM_ARGS=-Dlog4j.configurationFile=file:///etc/aws-kinesis/log4j.xml"
ExecStart=/usr/bin/start-aws-kinesis-agent -c /etc/aws-kinesis/agent.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=90
UMask=0027
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
printf '# Managed by native systemd service; legacy babysitter disabled.\n' >/etc/cron.d/aws-kinesis-agent
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/aws-kinesis-agent.service.d
cat >/etc/systemd/system/aws-kinesis-agent.service.d/java-memory.conf <<'UNIT'
[Service]
Environment="JAVA_START_HEAP=32m"
Environment="JAVA_MAX_HEAP=128m"
UNIT
# Preserve agent evidence too; no default seven-day log expiration.
cat >/etc/aws-kinesis/log4j.xml <<'LOG4J'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Configuration>
  <Appenders>
    <File name="FILE" fileName="/var/log/aws-kinesis-agent/aws-kinesis-agent.log">
      <PatternLayout pattern="%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSZ} (%t) %c [%p] %m%n" />
    </File>
  </Appenders>
  <Loggers>
    <Logger name="com.amazon.kinesis.streaming.agent.tailing.FirehoseSender" level="debug" />
    <Root level="info"><AppenderRef ref="FILE" /></Root>
  </Loggers>
</Configuration>
LOG4J
systemctl daemon-reload
squid -k parse
systemctl enable --now squid
systemctl enable --now aws-kinesis-agent
systemctl is-active --quiet squid
systemctl is-active --quiet aws-kinesis-agent
rpm -q squid aws-kinesis-agent > /var/log/squid-agent-versions.txt
"$JAVA17" -version >> /var/log/squid-agent-versions.txt 2>&1
sleep 5
systemctl is-active --quiet aws-kinesis-agent

Content.description: Change aggregation and poll settings without deleting checkpoints; generate no logs.

Properties.GroupDescription: Firehose PrivateLink: HTTPS from Squid EC2 security group only

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: No initiated outbound connections; response traffic is stateful

ServiceName.Description: Supply this exact string as ServiceName when deploying consumer stack.

ProxyPublicIpAz1.Description: One of two possible public egress IPs returned by checkip.amazonaws.com

ProxyPublicIpAz2.Description: Second possible public egress IP returned by checkip.amazonaws.com.

FirehoseEndpointId.Description: Firehose private interface endpoint in both provider AZs; private DNS enabled.
